profiles.Summary: Celeste is a lightweight 2D indie platformer that runs exceptionally well on the Steam Deck, easily hitting 60 fps at full resolution with minimal hardware demands. Its PC minimum requirements are well below the Deck's capabilities, making it one of the most effortless titles on the device.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 3 W TDP and minimum GPU clock, Celeste runs comfortably at a locked 30 fps with enormous headroom to spare; battery life is exceptional for a long session. In-game graphics options are minimal for this 2D title, so TDP is the primary lever.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Celeste's engine targets 60 fps natively, so unlocking all limits yields a perfectly stable 60 fps with zero stutter; there is no practical gain from going further. Removing TDP and GPU limits simply lets the Deck run unconstrained, which is unnecessary but harmless.

Optimal.Notes: 60 fps is the native target Celeste was designed around and the Deck hits it effortlessly at a modest 5 W TDP; Integer scaling preserves the pixel-art aesthetic at native 1280x800.
